reason: Modify only model_design because the proposed change concerns token selection and loss aggregation inside SASRec.ranking_loss. Historical sampled-softmax experiments and the current 0.5312 macro validation HR@10 support retaining the existing architecture and 2,048-negative objective while testing user-balanced, endpoint-weighted supervision. Uniform flattened-token sampling favors longer histories and can omit endpoints; this is a plausible objective mismatch, not an established explanation for Electronics HR@10 of 0.425.

plan.model_design: Modify only SASRec.ranking_loss(self, seq, pos) to return the batch mean of 0.5 times each sequence's endpoint sampled-softmax loss plus 0.5 times its mean nonpadding-position loss, preserving existing variable names and function signatures. From the single all_features forward pass, identify endpoints using the last nonzero position of pos, always include them in indices, and allocate the remaining TOKEN_CAP=2048 budget across sequences through balanced quotas with uniform sampling without replacement among nonendpoint positions; reserve at least one such position per eligible sequence, which fits the current BATCH=128, and explicitly reject incompatible batch/cap settings rather than silently dropping endpoints. Compute unreduced float32 cross-entropy using the unchanged NEGATIVES=2048 shared uniform draws, sampling with replacement, learned item bias, target-collision masking at -1e4, and logits; estimate each sequence's full positional mean as (endpoint_loss + nonendpoint_count * sampled_nonendpoint_mean) / valid_count, with endpoint-only sequences using endpoint_loss, so mandatory endpoint inclusion does not bias the positional-mean term. Retain the 96-dimensional two-block SASRec, dropout, prefix augmentation, batch size, AdamW, warmup, clipping, environment-controlled SASREC_EPOCHS default 200, runtime limits, validation schedule and checkpoint selection; compare against 0.5312 using the unchanged pinned host macro HR@10 evaluation, treating a 0.005–0.015 gain as a hypothesis. Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training/evaluation seed 42, supplied splits, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four category routes, trial-local artifacts, predict and write_predict_script with identical validation/inference scoring, and exactly one newly trained checkpoint per category on a single GPU, without ensembles, checkpoint averaging, external scoring components, other-trial checkpoint reuse, or hidden-test access.
